Definition or setting: 102 participants; supplied labels retained (72 non-halitosis, 30 halitosis); only the 16 PCR species were used.
Age (numeric); sex, smoking and oral hygiene (categorical). All non-Dummy models include these four variables.
Raw copies/mL; training-fitted z-score standardization. No global log transformation or total-load normalization was applied to these predictive inputs.

Pooled positive Pearson r > 0.4 connected components. The largest and second cluster are redefined using only each inner or outer training subset. Connected paths need not meet r > 0.4 for every pair.
One numeric input: the mean log10(copies/mL + 1) across species in that training-defined largest cluster. It is used with the four clinical variables and is restricted to linear models.
Inner CV chooses the single species and its tuned model setting; the selected species is refitted on the outer training fold and evaluated on its untouched test fold.

Classification predicts the original training-fold positive proportion for every test participant. Regression predicts the outer training-fold target mean. Dummy uses neither clinical nor PCR predictors and is not oversampled.
No analysis-variable values were missing. The executed configuration raises an error for missing predictors; no imputation-based sensitivity analysis is claimed.
Training-fitted category codes are supplied to SMOTENC; valid categorical values are checked. Final estimator inputs use one-hot encoding; test-fold categories do not inform fitted encoding.
SMOTENC in classification training folds only, k_neighbors = 5. Regression is not oversampled. Main classification uses no simultaneous class weighting.
No oversampling; LogisticRegression class_weight = balanced. This is a separate analysis from SMOTENC.
scikit-learn LogisticRegression with L2 penalty, lbfgs, max_iter = 5000; Ridge regression for gas concentrations.
Logistic C and Ridge alpha: 0.01, 0.1, 1, 10. Three inner folds; maximize mean AUROC for classification and minimize mean MSE for regression.
Five outer folds repeated ten times, random seed 42. Stratified folds for classification; K-fold for regression. Test data are not oversampled.
Predicted positive at probability ≥ 0.5. AUROC does not use that decision threshold.
Pool the five test folds within each repetition, calculate each metric, and average the ten repetition-specific metrics. Report repetition SD, fold SD and bootstrap CI separately.

10,000 participant resamples; all repeated predictions and paired models stay with each participant. Classification resampling preserves class counts. CIs hold saved predictions fixed and exclude refitting/selection uncertainty.
Refit with log1p target ln(1 + y), where y is concentration in ppb. Report log-scale R2 separately from inverse-transformed raw-ppb R2, MAE and RMSE.
1 − SSEmodel/SSEreference, with each test participant reference set to the matching outer training-fold mean. This differs from conventional R2 based on the evaluation-set mean.

100 permutations; observed and null outer 5-fold × 2 repeats with inner 3-fold CV. Reshuffle labels by participant, re-stratify classification folds, and rerun preprocessing, cluster definition, model selection and fitting.

21 non-Dummy linear classification specifications; 21 per gas and 63 across all three gases. Dummy is excluded from the maximum. This numerical family covers linear models only. Permutation inference is restricted to the linear candidates.
22 linear specifications for classification and for each of the three gases; 88 outcome-specific results. The 22 include Dummy and the nested selector.

Locally implemented PyTorch feature Transformer; no positional encoding. Grid: embedding 16, 32 or 64; heads 4; depth 3; learning rate 0.0001; 100 epochs; batch 8; dropout 0.1; no early stopping.
